title: IMU Sliding Window with std::deque
hints: `std::deque` gives O(1) `push_back` **and** `pop_front`. Doing `erase(begin())` on a `std::vector` is O(n).
push: reject if `!buf_.empty() && s.t < buf_.back().t`. Then push_back, and `while (buf_.front().t < s.t - window_) pop_front();`.
Keep running sums `sum_[3]`: add on push, subtract on pop. meanGyro is then `sum_[i] / buf_.size()`. Guard against empty.
between(): deque iterators are random access, so `std::lower_bound` with a `(const ImuSample&, double)` comparator finds t0 in O(log n). Then walk forward while `t <= t1`.
